OnePlus FPC1020 fingerprint sensor

Required properties:
- compatible: Must be "fpc,fpc1020".
- fpc,irq-gpio: GPIO connected to the sensor interrupt.
- fpc,enable-gpio: GPIO used to enable the sensor.

The interrupt-parent and interrupts properties describe the same sensor
interrupt.  The established board node also supplies reset and enable
pinctrl states, a vdd_ana supply, and the fpc,enable-on-boot and
fpc,enable-wakeup flags.
